For progress updates in redirected output, pass `Console(force_interactive=True)` to `Progress`; Rich disables animations by default when output isn't interactive. See [Interactive mode](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst#interactive_mode) and use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) for further usage questions.
